expected_evidence: record of Commission advice and cooperation with the Cooperation Group and ENISA

note: Article 14(4), point (e), is a cross-reference and is not copied. The duty in this sentence is on the Commission. It is not a duty written onto ENISA or the Cooperation Group. A company consultation record is not evidence of this duty.

references.law_text:
The Commission shall exchange advice and cooperate with the Cooperation Group
and ENISA on the draft implementing acts in accordance with Article 14(4),
point (e).

remediation_hint: Look for exchange of advice and cooperation with the Cooperation Group and ENISA on the draft implementing acts, as referred to in Article 14(4), point (e).
scope: exchange advice and cooperate with the Cooperation Group and ENISA
